units.name: Run 005 Controlled Self-Notification
units.business_outcome: Prove one approved external notification with deterministic recipient, duplicate suppression, evidence and safe unknown-outcome handling.
allowed_actions: prepare one typed Gmail self-send handoff
prohibited_actions: send to any address other than the authenticated account
automatic retry after an unknown send outcome
units.failure_policy: reject authority expansion; suppress duplicates; stop and escalate unknown outcomes
